noise.text: Brown noise — the deepest of the noise colors, with most of its energy down low. A steady, rumbling wall of sound, closer to distant thunder or a heavy waterfall than to hissy static. Five hours of it, even and unbroken, to block out the world for deep focus, grounding, or sleep. Lossless WAV/FLAC on Patreon: A clean, continuously generated sound — no music, no narration. Follow for white, pink, grey and green noise too.

noise.text: Pink noise, deeper and softer than white noise, with more low-frequency weight and less hiss. Ten hours of a steady, digitally generated tone, good for sleep, focus, or masking background noise. Lossless WAV/FLAC on Patreon: A clean, continuously generated sound — no music, no narration.
